name: com.shaw1213.dreamlayer-unity
description: Makes DreamLayer images and sprite sheets game-ready in Unity: sprite-sheet ZIPs become sliced sprites and animation clips timed by each frame's own duration, with feet pivots, per-folder WebGL import rules, provenance files and an editor window that generates through the DreamLayer CLI. A community tool, not made by DreamLayer.

samples.description: DreamLayer's own 7-frame walk sprite ZIP (MIT, DreamLayer AI).
An 8-frame idle made with DreamLayer's idle preset (background kept, removed locally with Tools~).
